DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENT.title: Potent
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENT.description:
Potent 2+: every X Ability Potency, some of this card's stats or effects are increased.
Potent 1: some of this card's stats or effects are affected equal to your Ability Potency.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HEIGHTENED.title: Heightened
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-HEIGHTENED.description:
Heightened cards have their potency requirement met by 1.
Cards with potency 1 gain 3 Ability Potency.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-QUICKENED.title: Quickened
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-QUICKENED.description: Quickened cards also deal their effects to a random enemy (or ally).
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-RITUAL.title: Ritual
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-RITUAL.description: Ritual spells do not consume a Spellslot when your energy is above 50%.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCROLLED.title: Scrolled
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCROLLED.description: Scrolled spells are free but exhaust on play.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FINESSE.title: Finesse
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FINESSE.description: Finesse weapons can use Dexterity to add to their damage, whichever is highest.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TWOHANDED.title: Two-Handed
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TWOHANDED.description: Two-handed weapons deal 20% more damage on subsequent attacks with the same weapon.
